sections.name: About Us
sections.copy:
Excellence in Energy Solutions

Saraki Logistics Renewable Energy Limited stands at the forefront of Nigeria's energy sector, combining decades of oilfield services expertise with forward-thinking renewable energy solutions. Operating from our headquarters in Abeokuta, Ogun State, we serve clients across Nigeria with unwavering commitment to safety, reliability, and innovation.

Our comprehensive approach bridges traditional oil and gas operations with clean power technologies, positioning us uniquely to support Nigeria's energy transition. Whether you require robust logistics for oilfield operations or sustainable renewable energy installations, our experienced team delivers solutions that exceed industry standards.

As Saraki Logistics Clean Power Solutions, we understand that Nigeria's energy future demands both reliability and sustainability. Our director brings extensive oilfield services experience, ensuring every project benefits from deep industry knowledge and professional execution.

sections.name: Our Services
sections.copy:
Comprehensive Energy Solutions

Oilfield Services
Complete logistics support for oil and gas operations including equipment transportation, supply chain management, and field support services. Our proven track record ensures seamless operations and minimized downtime for your critical projects.

Renewable Energy Solutions
From solar power installations to hybrid energy systems, we design and implement clean energy solutions tailored to Nigerian businesses and communities. Reduce operational costs while contributing to environmental sustainability.

Energy Logistics & Supply Chain
End-to-end logistics management for energy sector clients. We handle procurement, warehousing, transportation, and distribution with the precision and reliability your operations demand.

Project Management & Consulting
Expert guidance for energy infrastructure projects. Our team provides technical consulting, feasibility studies, and full project management services from concept to commissioning.

Maintenance & Technical Support
Ongoing maintenance services for both conventional and renewable energy installations. Our responsive technical team ensures optimal performance and maximum uptime for your energy assets.

sections.name: Why Choose Saraki Logistics
sections.copy:
Your Success is Our Priority

Proven Industry Expertise
Years of hands-on experience in oilfield services and renewable energy, led by a seasoned Oilfield Services Director who understands the unique challenges of Nigeria's energy sector.

Comprehensive Service Portfolio
One trusted partner for all your energy needs—from traditional oil and gas logistics to cutting-edge renewable power solutions. Streamline your vendor relationships while maintaining the highest standards.

Local Knowledge, Global Standards
Deep understanding of Nigerian business environment combined with international best practices. We navigate local regulations and logistics challenges while delivering world-class service quality.

Safety First Culture
Uncompromising commitment to health, safety, and environmental standards. Every project is executed with rigorous safety protocols protecting your team, assets, and community.

Reliable Project Delivery
On-time, on-budget execution backed by robust project management systems. We understand that delays cost money—our track record speaks to our reliability.
